name: parley-vscode
description: Interact with MIT Parley agents from Visual Studio Code with safe context sharing and diff review.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Parley runs, but settings that can execute code or redirect your API key are ignored from an untrusted workspace's settings (they fall back to your user settings). Trust the workspace to let its .vscode/settings.json configure the API endpoint, lifecycle hooks, MCP servers, and the ffmpeg path.

commands.title: Parley: New Conversation in New Window
Parley: Add File to Chat Context

parley.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible MIT Parley API.

parley.accountId.markdownDescription: Your Parley account id (e.g. `acc_…`), used by **`Parley: Show Usage`** to fetch real billed spend. Find it in the Parley Admin Portal under **My Account**. You'll be prompted for it on first use.

parley.defaultAgent.markdownDescription: Default model identifier (e.g. `bedrock/claude-sonnet-4-6`, `openai/gpt-5.1`, `google/gemini-3.1-pro`). Run `Parley: Set API Key` then pick from the model dropdown in the chat view.

parley.stream.markdownDescription: Stream Parley replies token-by-token in the chat view.

enumDescriptions: No extended thinking (default)
Adaptive — the model decides how much to reason (required for Claude Opus 4.7 on Bedrock)
Enabled with a 4,096-token reasoning budget
Enabled with an 8,192-token reasoning budget
Enabled with a 16,000-token reasoning budget
parley.thinking.markdownDescription: Extended thinking: makes the model reason step-by-step before answering, sent as the Parley `thinking` parameter. Supported on Claude, OpenAI reasoning models, and Gemini. Enabled levels also raise `max_tokens` to leave room for the answer. Thinking increases output-token usage (and cost). Also switchable from the **Mode** popover in the composer.

enumDescriptions: Answer only — no agent, no file access
Agent tools; approve each edit in a diff
Agent tools; apply edits automatically (revertible)
Agent reads the repo read-only and proposes a plan
Agent decides and applies edits automatically
CAUTION: auto-applies edits AND runs shell commands without asking
parley.defaultMode.markdownDescription: Default chat **Mode**, also switchable from the Mode popover in the composer. Shell commands always require confirmation regardless of mode.

enumDescriptions: Parley's standard voice — concise and technical
Minimal prose; lead with the answer or the code
Explain the reasoning and trade-offs behind the work
Teach as you go; invite the user to try small pieces
parley.outputStyle.markdownDescription: Communication **output style** prepended to the system prompt. Switch quickly with **`Parley: Select Output Style`**. Custom styles can be added as `.parley/output-styles/*.md` (filename = id, body = instruction).

enumDescriptions: Replace detected credentials with a marker before sending (recommended)
Leave content unchanged but note what was detected
Do not scan outbound content
parley.secretScanning.markdownDescription: Scan **outbound** context and tool results (a file the agent read, command output) for credential patterns (AWS/GitHub/OpenAI/Anthropic/Slack/Stripe/Google keys, PEM blocks) before they reach the gateway. Complements the sensitive-file denylist. High-confidence prefixes only, so false positives are rare.

parley.autoContinue.markdownDescription: In agent modes, keep working automatically (up to a safety cap) until the task is complete, instead of stopping for you to say "continue". The agent signals completion with a `<DONE>` marker.

parley.maxToolRounds.markdownDescription: Maximum tool-call rounds the agent may take within a single turn before pausing. When the limit is reached the agent keeps its tools and auto-continues into the next step (it does not lose access to its tools), so raising this mainly reduces turn boundaries on long tasks.

parley.maxAutoContinue.markdownDescription: Maximum number of times Parley auto-continues a turn before pausing for you. `0` disables auto-continue.

parley.tokenLimit.markdownDescription: Token budget per conversation. When the conversation's total token usage reaches this, Parley stops and asks you to raise the limit or start a new conversation. **`0` means unlimited (default).** Set it from `Parley: Set Token Limit`.

parley.usageWarnUsd.markdownDescription: Show a one-time warning in the conversation once its **estimated** spend crosses this many US dollars (a soft budget — the turn still continues). **`0` disables it (default).** For your real billed spend, use the 💰 button or `Parley: Show Usage`.

parley.autoCompactTokens.markdownDescription: When the conversation's size exceeds this many tokens, automatically compact (summarize) it before the next turn to control cost and avoid context-window errors. The size is measured with Parley's `/v1/messages/count_tokens` endpoint when available, falling back to a character-based estimate. **`0` disables (default).** (Compaction is lossy — it replaces history with a summary.) The agent loop also trims stale tool outputs automatically regardless of this setting.

parley.mcpServers.markdownDescription: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose to the agent, keyed by name. Three transports: **stdio** `{ "command": string, "args"?: string[], "env"?: object }`, **streamable HTTP** `{ "url": string, "headers"?: object }`, and **legacy SSE** `{ "url": string, "type": "sse", "headers"?: object }`. Their tools appear to the model as `mcp__<name>__<tool>`. Examples: `{ "filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "${workspaceFolder}"] }, "github": { "url": "https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <PAT>" } } }`. Run **`Parley: Reconnect MCP Servers`** after editing.

url.description: Endpoint for the HTTP (streamable) or SSE transport.

type.description: Transport. Defaults to stdio when `command` is set, http when `url` is set.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers (e.g. Authorization) for url-based transports.

parley.hooks.markdownDescription: Lifecycle hooks: shell commands that run at fixed points, receiving the event as JSON on stdin. Events: `PreToolUse` (exit 2 **blocks** the tool; stderr goes to the model), `PostToolUse` (exit 2 appends stderr as feedback), `UserPromptSubmit` (exit 2 blocks the prompt; exit 0 stdout is attached as context), `Stop` (notification when a turn finishes). `matcher` is a regex on the tool name. Example: `{ "PreToolUse": [{ "matcher": "run_command", "command": "node guard.js" }] }`.

enumDescriptions: Disable the web_search tool
DuckDuckGo — no API key required (default)
Google Programmable Search — needs apiKey + googleCx
Tavily — needs apiKey
parley.webSearch.provider.markdownDescription: Provider for the agent's `web_search` tool. **DuckDuckGo** works with no key. **Google** needs `parley.webSearch.apiKey` + `parley.webSearch.googleCx`; **Tavily** needs `parley.webSearch.apiKey`.

parley.webSearch.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the keyed web-search providers (Google Programmable Search or Tavily). Not needed for DuckDuckGo.

parley.webSearch.googleCx.markdownDescription: Google Programmable Search Engine ID (`cx`), required when `parley.webSearch.provider` is `google`.

parley.codebaseSearch.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable **`@codebase`** in the composer — retrieves the most relevant workspace files for your question and adds them as context.

enumDescriptions: Keyword ranking (ripgrep-style) — keyless, private, instant (default)
Local semantic embeddings (MiniLM, on-device) — true meaning-based search; downloads a model (~25 MB) on first index. Run 'Parley: Rebuild Codebase Index' to build it.
parley.codebaseSearch.provider.markdownDescription: How **`@codebase`** ranks files. **`lexical`** (default) is keyword-based and instant. **`local`** uses an on-device embedding model for true semantic search — keyless and private, but downloads a model on first use and you must run **`Parley: Rebuild Codebase Index`**. Falls back to lexical if the index isn't built or the model can't load.

parley.commandTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long a single agent shell command (`run_command`) may run before it's terminated. Default **300s** (5 min) so real `npm install` / build / test commands can finish. Raise it for slower builds.

parley.autoSaveConversations.markdownDescription: Automatically save each conversation as a Markdown file after every turn, so your history is preserved on disk. See `parley.conversationsDir` for the location, or run **`Parley: Open Conversations Folder`**.

parley.conversationsDir.markdownDescription: Folder where conversations are auto-saved. Leave empty to use the extension's global storage folder (open it with **`Parley: Open Conversations Folder`**). Set an absolute path to keep transcripts somewhere you choose.

parley.autoCompactPercent.markdownDescription: Automatically compact the conversation when it reaches this percentage of the model's context window. **Defaults to `80`**, so long conversations are summarized before they overflow the context (the most recent messages are kept verbatim). Uses the model's known context size and exact token counting. Set to **`0` to disable**. Works alongside `parley.autoCompactTokens` — whichever triggers first.

parley.inlineCompletion.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Parley inline (ghost-text) code completions as you type. Toggle quickly with `Parley: Toggle Inline Completion`.

parley.inlineCompletion.model.markdownDescription: Model used for inline completions. Prefer a fast, inexpensive model.

parley.inlineCompletion.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Idle delay before requesting an inline completion, in milliseconds.

parley.video.maxFrames.markdownDescription: Maximum frames sampled from an attached video (evenly spread across its duration) and sent as images. Requires `ffmpeg` on PATH.

parley.video.frameWidth.markdownDescription: Width (px) that sampled video frames are downscaled to before sending, to bound payload size. Aspect ratio is preserved.

parley.video.maxAudioSeconds.markdownDescription: Maximum seconds of a video's audio track to extract when attaching audio, to bound payload size.

parley.video.ffmpegPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `ffmpeg` binary used for video frame/audio extraction. Leave empty to use `ffmpeg` from PATH. `ffprobe` is located beside it. Set this if PATH detection fails (common on Windows — point it at `ffmpeg.exe`).

parley.context.maxCharacters.markdownDescription: Maximum characters of code/context to include in a request.

parley.context.includeDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Include VS Code diagnostics when commands request problem context.

parley.context.respectGitignore.markdownDescription: Respect workspace .gitignore patterns when collecting file context.

parley.confirmBeforeSendingLargeContext.markdownDescription: Show a context preview and confirmation before sending larger requests.

parley.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable extension telemetry. This extension currently sends no telemetry.

parley.logLevel.markdownDescription: Controls extension output verbosity. Secrets and prompt contents are never logged.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
